description: AMD command encoding and rendering/media library. Only AMDGPU owns hardware; encoder capabilities are intersected with the active common backend.

functions.name: get_info

parameters.name: output
parameters.description: Caller buffer; changed only on success.

parameters.name: output_bytes
parameters.description: Allocated output bytes, at least the fixed structure size.

operation.ownership: No retained memory, allocation, hardware access or shared mutable state.

functions.description: Return source/build identity. Zero capabilities is deliberate until real implementation; source compatibility is not device admission.

interfaces.description: Independent immutable library identity, append-only interface.

functions.name: negotiate

parameters.name: profile
parameters.description: Exact AMD profile and canonical device binding; never retained.

parameters.name: output
parameters.description: Unchanged on failure; disjoint from profile.

operation.ownership: Pure bounded negotiation; no device access, allocations or pointers retained.

functions.description: Validate the AMD-specific versioned protocol and report only implemented command capabilities. Zero features is a valid foundation result; it cannot select an accelerated provider.

functions.name: encode_copy

operation.ownership: Pure encoding into caller-owned output. No allocation, hardware access or retained pointers.

functions.description: Bounded SDMA4.1 packets into disjoint caller memory; failure changes neither commands nor written count. No fence or device access is implied.

functions.name: encode_fill

operation.ownership: Pure encoding into caller-owned output. No allocation, hardware access or retained pointers.

functions.description: Bounded SDMA4.1 packets into disjoint caller memory; failure changes neither commands nor written count. No fence or device access is implied.

functions.name: encode_pm4_frame

operation.ownership: Pure encoding into caller-owned output. No allocation, hardware access or retained pointers.

functions.description: Emit 48 graphics or 32 compute PM4 dwords; disjoint buffers and all fields are validated before output writes. No allocation, retention, submission or hardware access.

interfaces.description: AMD-only negotiation; separate from NVIDIA BACKEND_V1 even if individual payload sizes coincide.

functions.name: calculate

operation.ownership: Caller-owned disjoint inputs, outputs and 16-byte-aligned workspace. No heap, globals, hardware I/O or retained pointers. Do not reuse workspace concurrently.

functions.description: Calculate real GFX9 Addr2 surface and mip geometry. Outputs unchanged on failure; scratch may change. At most64KB scratch,15mips,64MB image. No retained allocations.

functions.name: address

operation.ownership: Caller-owned disjoint inputs, outputs and 16-byte-aligned workspace. No heap, globals, hardware I/O or retained pointers. Do not reuse workspace concurrently.

functions.description: Actual Addr2 coordinate calculation including tiled/mip/MSAA addressing.

functions.name: metadata

operation.ownership: Caller-owned disjoint inputs, outputs and 16-byte-aligned workspace. No heap, globals, hardware I/O or retained pointers. Do not reuse workspace concurrently.

functions.description: Reference-only DCC/HTILE geometry from Addr2. Never enables compression or accepts unknown metadata states.

functions.name: import_image

operation.ownership: Caller-owned disjoint inputs, outputs and 16-byte-aligned workspace. No heap, globals, hardware I/O or retained pointers. Do not reuse workspace concurrently.

functions.description: Recompute and validate BO import. Exact modifier/topology/epoch; insufficient or misaligned backing rejected. No BO retain or mapping: owner must retain it separately.

functions.name: descriptors

operation.ownership: Caller-owned disjoint inputs, outputs and 16-byte-aligned workspace. No heap, globals, hardware I/O or retained pointers. Do not reuse workspace concurrently.

functions.description: Recompute image layout before building uncompressed GFX9 texture/sampler/color resource descriptors; no caller-forged internal layout.

interfaces.description: GFX9 source-backed image layout and immutable provider descriptors, separate from active driver operations.

types.name: R4AmdInfo

fields.name: capability_flags
fields.description: Zero in 0.80.2; does not advertise GPU execution or runtime compilation.

types.description: Fixed ABI1 source/build identity, not a measured hardware profile.

types.name: R4AmdDriverProfile

fields.name: device_id
fields.description: PCI device ID; identity only, not device admission.

types.description: Opaque AMD payload in common GfxBackendProfile; tagged by this BACKEND_V1 interface ID, profile revision 1.

types.name: R4AmdDeviceProfile

fields.name: device_id
fields.description: PCI device ID; identity only, not device admission.

fields.name: device_generation
fields.description: Exact nonzero common queue device generation.

fields.name: reset_generation
fields.description: Exact nonzero common queue reset generation.

types.description: Negotiation binds an AMD IP/command profile to one common device/reset epoch; memory generation remains a separate common owner field.

types.name: R4AmdFeatures

fields.name: features
fields.description: Only implemented encoder operations; zero until the corresponding roadmap integration.

fields.name: gpu_address_bits
fields.description: Usable GPU address width, zero without an encoder.

fields.name: max_command_words
fields.description: Bounded command capacity, zero without an encoder.

types.description: A compatible profile is not an active GPU: effective operations are the intersection with actual common driver capabilities.

types.name: R4AmdCopy

fields.name: source_pitch
fields.description: Source row pitch; zero for one row.

fields.name: target_pitch
fields.description: Target row pitch; zero for one row.

types.description: Fixed SDMA4.1 request; all reserved fields and unsupported modifiers must be zero. Validation precedes output writes.

types.name: R4AmdFill
types.description: Fixed SDMA4.1 request; all reserved fields and unsupported modifiers must be zero. Validation precedes output writes.

types.name: R4AmdPm4Frame

fields.name: flags
fields.description: Bit 0 requests an EOP interrupt; all others zero.

fields.name: indirect_address
fields.description: 32-byte-aligned VMID1 address of a retained IB.

fields.name: fence_address
fields.description: 8-byte-aligned VMID0 address of a retained fence.

fields.name: eop_scratch
fields.description: Graphics: separate 256-byte-aligned/256-byte GFX9 EOP workaround storage in VMID0. Compute: zero.

fields.name: fence_sequence
fields.description: Exact nonzero token; all-ones poison is forbidden.

fields.name: command_dwords
fields.description: 1..2048 dwords; IB contents and resource retention remain with their owner.

types.description: Bounded GC9.1 outer ring frame: HDP, pipeline/cache barriers, VMID1 IB, EOP workaround and exact 64-bit fence. No device completion or shader/API capability is implied.

types.name: R4AmdImageRequest

fields.name: size
fields.description: Exact byte size of this fixed structure.

fields.name: gb_addr_config
fields.description: Actual post-initialization GB_ADDR_CONFIG: geometry and modifier topology.

fields.name: chip_revision
fields.description: Confirmed external ASIC revision 0x41..0x48, not PCI revision.

fields.name: usage
fields.description: Bits: texture1, color2, storage4, scanout8, depth16.

fields.name: swizzle
fields.description: Original GFX9 AddrSwizzleMode, checked by AddrLib.

fields.name: pitch
fields.description: Requested pitch in bytes; zero lets AddrLib choose.

fields.name: modifier
fields.description: Exact DRM modifier, including topology bits; zero only for linear.

types.description: Immutable GFX9 image request. Measured GB_ADDR_CONFIG and external ASIC revision, never PCI revision. Dimensions <=16384, mips<=15, samples1/2/4/8, 64MB owner bound. No compression state is accepted.

types.name: R4AmdImageLayout

fields.name: size
fields.description: Exact byte size of this fixed structure.

fields.name: byte_length
fields.description: Backing size in bytes, including padding.

fields.name: epitch
fields.description: Hardware EPITCH from mip-chain pitch/height per epitchIsHeight.

fields.name: element_bits
fields.description: Storage element bits; 64/128 for BC blocks.

fields.name: swizzle
fields.description: Original GFX9 AddrSwizzleMode, checked by AddrLib.

fields.name: flags
fields.description: Output bits: scanout1, tiled2. No compression.

fields.name: gb_addr_config
fields.description: Actual post-initialization GB_ADDR_CONFIG: geometry and modifier topology.

types.description: Stable derived surface description. Pitch is bytes; mip records distinguish elements/pixels and macro-block/tail positions. No upstream pointers or C++ layouts cross the interface.

types.name: R4AmdMip

fields.name: pitch
fields.description: Padded pitch in storage elements, not bytes.

fields.name: offset
fields.description: AddrLib offset, not a swizzle coordinate.

types.description: One AddrLib mip record; pitch in elements. Caller supplies at most15 records.

types.name: R4AmdCoordinate

fields.name: size
fields.description: Exact byte size of this fixed structure.

fields.name: x
fields.description: Element X at selected mip; BC uses blocks.

fields.name: y
fields.description: Element Y at selected mip; BC uses blocks.

types.description: Coordinates in format elements; bounded to the selected logical mip/slice/sample.

fields.name: size
fields.description: Exact byte size of this fixed structure.

fields.name: offset
fields.description: Exact Addr2 byte offset; not a CPU pointer.

types.name: R4AmdMetadata

fields.name: size
fields.description: Exact byte size of this fixed structure.

fields.name: byte_length
fields.description: Backing size in bytes, including padding.

fields.name: slice_bytes
fields.description: HTILE slice allocation bytes. Zero for GFX9 DCC, whose API exposes only the separate fast-clear extent.

fields.name: fast_clear_bytes
fields.description: GFX9 DCC fast-clear bytes per slice; distinct from full slice storage. Zero for HTILE.

types.description: Reference-only DCC or HTILE geometry. Flags stay zero: transitions/initialization are not enabled and this is not a usable compressed image.

types.name: R4AmdImageImport

fields.name: size
fields.description: Exact byte size of this fixed structure.

fields.name: byte_length
fields.description: Backing size in bytes, including padding.

fields.name: offset
fields.description: Aligned image byte offset within backing.

fields.name: adapter_id
fields.description: Canonical owning adapter, must match expected_adapter.

fields.name: memory_generation
fields.description: Canonical memory generation, independent of queue generation.

fields.name: metadata_state
fields.description: Exactly zero; compression transitions are not implemented.

fields.name: usage
fields.description: Bits: texture1, color2, storage4, scanout8, depth16.

types.description: Import from the common BO descriptor. Metadata state must be zero; adapter/epoch, alignment, offset, pitch, size and modifier must exactly support the derived image.

types.name: R4AmdImageView

fields.name: size
fields.description: Exact byte size of this fixed structure.

fields.name: address
fields.description: 48-bit GPU VA of retained backing, aligned to layout alignment.

fields.name: byte_length
fields.description: Backing size in bytes, including padding.

fields.name: offset
fields.description: Aligned image byte offset within backing.

fields.name: first_layer
fields.description: First included layer; zero for a full 3D volume.

fields.name: last_layer
fields.description: Last included layer; depth minus one for 3D.

fields.name: first_mip
fields.description: First included mip; 3D color requires zero.

fields.name: min_lod
fields.description: Unsigned fixed point with 8 fractional bits.

fields.name: max_lod
fields.description: Unsigned fixed point with 8 fractional bits, at most 15*256.

fields.name: lod_bias
fields.description: Signed fixed point with 8 fractional bits; -4096..4095.

types.description: GFX9 texture/sampler and color target descriptor request. Caller retains VA/backing through the associated queue fence. Uncompressed views only; no command submission.

types.name: R4AmdImageDescriptors

fields.name: size
fields.description: Exact byte size of this fixed structure.

types.description: GFX9 source-derived resource words; color words ordered as documented in the API. Immutable data, no live rendering capability.

types.name: R4AmdArchitecture

fields.name: size
fields.description: Exact byte size of this fixed structure.

fields.name: gb_addr_config
fields.description: Actual post-initialization GB_ADDR_CONFIG: geometry and modifier topology.

fields.name: chip_revision
fields.description: Confirmed external ASIC revision 0x41..0x48, not PCI revision.

fields.name: memory_generation
fields.description: Canonical memory generation, independent of queue generation.

types.description: Measured AMD image profile in common backend properties (IMAGE_V1 identity, revision1). Flags/reserved zero; describes geometry, not render/present capability. ASIC revision is external, not PCI revision.
